description:
We commit to delivering our services as fast as possible to our customers and as a minimum within 10 minutes for extractions for 90% of all requests that are less than 10 pages and classify intent faster than 5 minutes for all of our services.

For us to better know if we do this we need a dashboard that can help us monitor this.

WITH time_series AS (
  SELECT
    GENERATE_SERIES(
      $__timeFrom() :: timestamp,
      $__timeTo() :: timestamp,
      '$time_interval' :: interval
    ) AS date_time
),
events_data AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_BIN('$time_interval', date_time, '2000-1-1') AS time,
    AVG(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS mean
  FROM
    metrics.events
  WHERE
    event = 'saga_processing_time'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_time)
    AND org IN ($org)
    AND intent IN ($intent)
    AND (
      (
        'Production' IN ('${env:csv}')
        AND (
          is_qa IS NULL
          OR is_qa = FALSE
        )
      )
      OR (
        'Quality Assurance' IN ('${env:csv}')
        AND is_qa = TRUE
      )
    )
  GROUP BY
    time
)
SELECT
  date_time,
  COALESCE(mean, 0) AS mean
FROM
  time_series
  LEFT JOIN events_data ON DATE_BIN('$time_interval', date_time, '2000-1-1') = time
WHERE
  'mean' IN ($metric)
ORDER BY
  date_time;

SELECT
  AVG(CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS "mean",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.50) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS "median",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.90) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS "p90",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS "p95",
  PERCENTILE_CONT(0.99) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY CAST(value AS DECIMAL(10, 3))) AS "p99"
FROM
  metrics.events
WHERE
  event = 'saga_processing_time'
  AND $__timeFilter(date_time)
  AND org IN ($org)
  AND intent IN ($intent)
  AND (
    ('Production' IN ('${env:csv}') AND (is_qa IS NULL OR is_qa = FALSE))
    OR ('Quality Assurance' IN ('${env:csv}') AND is_qa = TRUE)
  );

WITH time_series AS (
  SELECT
    GENERATE_SERIES(
      $__timeFrom(),
      $__timeTo(),
      '$time_interval'::interval
    ) AS dt
),
events_data AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_BIN('$time_interval', date_time, '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) AS time,
    COUNT(value) AS count
  FROM
    metrics.events
  WHERE
    event = 'saga_processing_time'
    AND $__timeFilter(date_time)
    AND org IN ($org)
    AND intent IN ($intent)
    AND (
      ('Production' IN ('${env:csv}') AND (is_qa IS NULL OR is_qa = FALSE))
      OR ('Quality Assurance' IN ('${env:csv}') AND is_qa = TRUE)
    )
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  dt AS "time",
  COALESCE(ed.count, 0) AS "ML logs"
FROM
  time_series ts
  LEFT JOIN events_data ed ON DATE_BIN('$time_interval', ts.dt, '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) = ed.time
ORDER BY 1;

WITH time_series AS (
  SELECT
    GENERATE_SERIES(
      $__timeFrom(),
      $__timeTo(),
      '$time_interval'::interval
    ) AS dt
),
events_data AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_BIN('$time_interval', sent_at, '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) AS time,
    COUNT(mail_envelope_id) AS count
  FROM
    bc.mail_envelope
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(sent_at)
    AND org_id IN ($org)
    AND saga_classification IN ($intent)
  GROUP BY time
)
SELECT
  dt AS "time",
  COALESCE(ed.count, 0) AS "Platform logs"
FROM
  time_series ts
  LEFT JOIN events_data ed ON DATE_BIN('$time_interval', ts.dt, '1970-01-01Z'::timestamptz) = ed.time
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS "Platform Total"
FROM
  bc.mail_envelope
WHERE
  $__timeFilter(sent_at)
  AND org_id IN ($org)
  AND saga_classification IN ($intent);

SELECT
  bucket_count || ' @ ' || 
  TO_CHAR(time AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Copenhagen', 'HH24:MI') || '-' || 
  TO_CHAR((time + '$time_interval'::interval) AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Copenhagen', 'HH24:MI') AS "Platform Peak"
FROM (
  SELECT
    DATE_BIN('$time_interval'::interval, sent_at, '1970-01-01'::timestamp) AS time,
    COUNT(*) AS bucket_count
  FROM
    bc.mail_envelope
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter(sent_at)
    AND org_id IN ($org)
    AND saga_classification IN ($intent)
  GROUP BY time
  ORDER BY bucket_count DESC, time ASC
  LIMIT 1
) AS subquery;

The filter lists BOTH the raw probe paths and the normalised bucket names (`probe`/`metadata`/`blocked`/`other`) so it stays correct regardless of whether the mesh-default Istio Telemetry is normalising paths. This panel is the source for the alert '% of succesfull calls (HTTP, gRPC)' — keep the two expressions in sync.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  org_id,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(created_at))) AS delay_seconds
FROM
  bc.mail_envelope me
WHERE
  org_id IN ($org)
  AND org_id NOT LIKE '%\_shadow%'
  AND (intent IN ($intent) OR intent = 'unknown')
  AND created_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hours'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bc.events e
    WHERE e.mail_envelope_id = me.mail_envelope_id
      AND e.event_type = 'process_completed'
  )
  AND status = 'processing'
GROUP BY 
  org_id
HAVING 
  NOW() - MIN(created_at) > INTERVAL '0 seconds'
  -- AND NOW() - MIN(created_at) < INTERVAL '1 day'
ORDER BY 
  delay_seconds DESC;
